lines.text: Adam! It's quarter to nine! Isn't your interview at ten?
What?! My phone died! My alarm didn't ring!
You're wearing jeans? To an interview?
No time, Mom! Bye!
Please, can you go faster?
Faster? Look at this traffic, my friend. Nobody is going anywhere.
Good morning. Can I help you?
Hi… sorry… I'm Adam Fares. I have an interview at ten. I'm late, I'm so sorry.
Please take a seat. Ms. Nadia will call you.
First interview?
Is it that obvious?
You're breathing very fast. And… you're wearing jeans.
Adam? Come in, please. I'm Nadia, the hiring manager. Have a seat.
Thank you.
So, Adam, tell me about yourself.
Um… my name is Adam. I am, like, twenty-three years old. I… um… graduated from university.
OK. Why do you want to work with us?
Because… um… I need a job. And the salary is good.
I see. Last question. How do you handle stress?
Stress? Um… I like working in a team. Teamwork is very important.
…Thank you, Adam. We will contact you.
That was terrible. "I like working in a team"? She asked about stress!
Maybe it wasn't that bad. Maybe they will call me.

options: he went to the wrong company

choice.q: What does Adam talk about when Nadia asks about stress?

questions.a: Because his phone died and his alarm didn't ring.

questions.q: What does Mom notice about Adam's clothes?
questions.a: He is wearing jeans to an interview.

questions.q: How does the other candidate know it's Adam's first interview?
questions.a: Adam is breathing very fast, and he is wearing jeans.

questions.q: What is Adam's answer to "Why do you want to work with us?"
questions.a: He says, "Because I need a job, and the salary is good."

questions.q: What mistake does Adam make with the stress question?
questions.a: He talks about teamwork, not about stress.

questions.q: If Nadia asked you "Tell me about yourself," what would you say?
questions.a: Example: I'm Mona. I'm a business graduate, and I love working with people.
